title: 共封裝光學交換器整合
summary: 從交換 ASIC、光引擎、雷射與散熱的共同介面拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate joint switch-ASIC, optical-engine, laser and cooling interfaces, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與容量
stages.description: 以三個技術單元檢查「系統邊界與容量」，每一單元交付設計模型及獨立判別證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine system boundary and capacity, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 系統邊界：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「系統邊界」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for system boundary, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「系統邊界」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。CPO 將光引擎靠近 ASIC，但外接光源、連接器與管理仍屬系統功耗與故障邊界。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「畫出從電源入口到光纖端口的方塊圖，標明計入與排除項。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for system boundary, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. CPO places optics near the ASIC, while external sources/connectors/management remain in system power and fault boundaries. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Draw from power input to fiber ports and mark included/excluded terms. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 畫出從電源入口到光纖端口的方塊圖，標明計入與排除項。
steps.observationEn: Draw from power input to fiber ports and mark included/excluded terms.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：雙向總量可以直接當單向有效容量。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Bidirectional aggregate equals one-way useful capacity. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交系統邊界的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「畫出從電源入口到光纖端口的方塊圖，標明計入與排除項。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for system boundary, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Draw from power input to fiber ports and mark included/excluded terms.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: Psystem=ΣPi；Ebit=Psystem/Ruseful，頻寬與功耗的邊界必須相同。 固定滿載、未加備援與冷卻設施功耗；教學數字不代表任何商用 CPO。

quiz.question: 要審查「系統邊界」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing system boundary?
options: CPO 將光引擎靠近 ASIC，但外接光源、連接器與管理仍屬系統功耗與故障邊界。

optionsEn: CPO places optics near the ASIC, while external sources/connectors/management remain in system power and fault boundaries.

steps.title: 系統邊界：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「系統邊界」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for system boundary, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。畫出從電源入口到光纖端口的方塊圖，標明計入與排除項。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「CPO 將光引擎靠近 ASIC，但外接光源、連接器與管理仍屬系統功耗與故障邊界。」與錯誤假說「光引擎靠近 ASIC 就不再需要熱設計。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Draw from power input to fiber ports and mark included/excluded terms. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "CPO places optics near the ASIC, while external sources/connectors/management remain in system power and fault boundaries." against the incorrect hypothesis "Optics near an ASIC no longer need thermal design."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 畫出從電源入口到光纖端口的方塊圖，標明計入與排除項。

steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Optics near an ASIC no longer need thermal design. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交系統邊界的量測判別表：畫出從電源入口到光纖端口的方塊圖，標明計入與排除項。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for system boundary: Draw from power input to fiber ports and mark included/excluded terms. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

steps.title: 電通道縮短：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Short electrical channels: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「電通道縮短」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for short electrical channels, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。比較長短電通道 S 參數與眼圖，保持資料率及端接相同。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「縮短電路可能降低損失與等化需求，仍需封裝返回路徑和接點模型。」與錯誤假說「雙向總量可以直接當單向有效容量。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。 假想系統有 ASIC 600 W、8 個光引擎每個 15 W、外接雷射 40 W、控制 10 W，系統合計 770 W。若8個引擎每個單向 1.6 Tb/s，單向總量 12.8 Tb/s；770/12.8×10¹²=60.2 pJ/bit 是此系統邊界的平均能量，不能稱為光子晶片本身能效。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Compare S-parameters and eyes at matched data rate and termination. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Shorter links can reduce loss/equalization but still need return paths and joint models." against the incorrect hypothesis "Bidirectional aggregate equals one-way useful capacity."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. A hypothetical system has a 600 W ASIC, eight 15 W engines, 40 W external lasers and 10 W control: 770 W. Eight 1.6 Tb/s one-way engines total 12.8 Tb/s. 770/(12.8×10¹²)=60.2 pJ/bit is system-boundary energy, not intrinsic photonic-chip efficiency.
steps.observation: 比較長短電通道 S 參數與眼圖，保持資料率及端接相同。
steps.observationEn: Compare S-parameters and eyes at matched data rate and termination.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：雙向總量可以直接當單向有效容量。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Bidirectional aggregate equals one-way useful capacity. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交電通道縮短的量測判別表：比較長短電通道 S 參數與眼圖，保持資料率及端接相同。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for short electrical channels: Compare S-parameters and eyes at matched data rate and termination. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.
